name: Bindless Textures in CUDA
definition: An object-oriented approach using the CUDA API to upload textures into VRAM and expose them via texture object descriptors, eliminating the need for per-frame binding and mapping required by OpenGL-CUDA interoperability for textures.
summary: Bindless Textures in CUDA enable direct, high-performance texture sampling in kernels without OpenGL binding overhead, supporting a dynamic number of textures simultaneously.
